title: Define the complete versioned workspace bundle
description: Define one inspectable WorkspaceBundle containing every implemented durable record, named snapshot, referenced binary asset, schema metadata, integrity manifest, and export metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: The bundle schema registers every durable repository/type implemented through TASK-83
Records are grouped by versioned type and all referenced records/assets resolve within the bundle
Integrity metadata covers canonical record data and exact binary asset bytes
Export metadata is deterministic where required and excludes secrets, transient undo state, zoom, caches, and executable content
An unregistered durable record type causes a blocking completeness error

steps.details: Enumerate projects, drafts, named snapshots, layouts/revisions, templates/data/assignments, assets, setups/revisions/attestations, profiles, preparations, and sheet instances implemented by this release.
Add versioned serializable WorkspaceBundle groups, schema/export metadata, deterministic integrity entries, and internal reference identities.
Require each application-owned durable repository to register export, import validation, migration, and deletion participation; fail closed for omissions.
Verify full inventory inclusion, missing registration failure, dangling reference failure, asset-byte hashing, and transient/secret exclusion.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; inventory current registries and define contracts without implementing export UI.
Keep this task to contracts and registry completeness; download generation follows in TASK-85.
Later durable types such as calibration drafts must register when implemented, without pretending they exist in the current release.
